method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Reference lays out five sections in columns; built stacks cards in two columns with different grouping.
Four seed swatches with selection ring.
Built uses a family combobox and weight combobox; the reference lists families inline with samples and a weight segmented control.
Three-way language control and two sliders with live sample. Family and weight are Material selects with their own search; sliders are Material sliders (repaired 2026-09-02).
Override sliders now carry a caption with the property name and live value (repaired 2026-09-02); the reference edits overrides per element rather than on this row.

defects.summary: Section layout and typography control anatomy differ

deviations.reason: The reference draws the earlier Material 3 slider (thin track, round thumb). The built app uses the current Material Design 3 slider anatomy (16 px track, 4 px handle bar, stop indicator, value label) because the owner asked for every control to be pure Material Design 3; the mismatch percentage rises by about 0.75 points for it.
deviations.approval: Owner direction 2026-09-02: every control must be 100% Material Design 3; the current slider anatomy is the conforming one.
